package_operation_start.dry_run: native lifecycle preflight plus download_plan; no payload transfer or installation
package_operation_start.execute: return operation immediately; detached worker invokes the existing native lifecycle

package_operation_cancel.effect: cooperative cancellation before native registration; retained partial bytes are not installed

storage.authority: observation and transfer bytes only; never version selection, activation, installed registry or lifecycle truth
storage.private_access: authorize with the existing registry provider before each acquisition, including cache reuse

transfer.implementation: system curl with HTTP Range, then SHA-256 and size verification
transfer.retry: up to three attempts for transient failures; preserve partial bytes between operations
transfer.timeout: 10 second connect timeout; 120 second no-progress timeout; no fixed total download deadline
transfer.fallback: a server rejecting Range restarts a bounded download; corrupt bytes are discarded
transfer.disk: check remaining archive space before download and actual archive-member bytes before extraction and staging
transfer.success: only after the existing native lifecycle returns its verified installed readback
